title: Weakly supervised neural network: segmentation of complex structures in X-ray microCT
abstract: arXiv:2609.07313v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Segmentation of complex structures in X-ray tomographic data is a fundamental task in biomedical research, but it often requires large amounts of precisely annotated data, making fully supervised approaches costly and difficult to scale. In this study, weakly supervised deep learning is investigated as a strategy to reduce annotation effort while maintaining accurate segmentation. A two-dimensional convolutional neural network based on the nnU-Net framework was adapted to a weak supervision setting using sparse dot-based annotations, complemented by a limited number of fully segmented images. The approach was evaluated on high-resolution microCT slices of rat kidneys, targeting the segmentation of renal glomeruli, which are small, low-contrast anatomical structures. translated_title: 弱监督神经网络：X射线显微CT中复杂结构的分割
translated_abstract: X射线断层扫描数据中复杂结构的分割是生物医学研究中的一项基础任务，但它通常需要大量精确标注的数据，使得全监督方法成本高昂且难以规模化。本研究探讨了弱监督深度学习作为一种在保持准确分割的同时减少标注工作量的策略。基于nnU-Net框架的二维卷积神经网络被适配到弱监督设置中，使用稀疏的点标注，并辅以少量完全分割的图像。该方法在大鼠肾脏的高分辨率microCT切片上进行了评估，目标是对肾小球进行分割，肾小球是一种体积小、对比度低的解剖结构。结果表明，弱监督能够提供有意义的学习信号，即使在没有密集标注的情况下，也能实现肾小球的可靠定位。结合……
tldr: 本研究提出一种基于nnU-Net的弱监督深度学习方法，仅使用稀疏点标注和少量完整分割图像，即可在大鼠肾脏microCT图像中实现对肾小球这类小尺度低对比度结构的可靠定位与分割。
en_tdlr: This study shows that a weakly supervised nnU-Net-based approach using sparse dot annotations supplemented by a few fully segmented images can reliably segment and localize small, low-contrast renal glomeruli in high-resolution microCT images of rat kidneys.
